_doc: What standing buys. Two ranks a faction — Trusted at +20, Sworn at +60 — and each one opens something only that faction has. This is the long reason to pick a side, because you cannot be Sworn to two factions who are at odds (a deed for one is a third of a deed against the other, see js/factions.js).

wardens_reach.name: The road is watched
wardens_reach.desc: Their patrols join any fight you start within forty metres of them.

wardens_reach.name: A warden of your own
wardens_reach.desc: A road warden walks with you for as long as you stay in one zone.

ashen_pact.name: Not worth the trouble
ashen_pact.desc: Raid bands walk past you instead of at you.

ashen_pact.name: Say the word
ashen_pact.desc: Once a day, name a rival camp in this zone and they will burn it for you.

lantern_house.name: They know what it is
lantern_house.desc: Anything with a history sells for 40% more.

lantern_house.name: A lamp that does not go out
lantern_house.desc: A light source that never burns down and never needs oil.

cutwater.name: Free water
cutwater.desc: Every ferry landing on the world takes you across for nothing.

cutwater.name: A fast boat
cutwater.desc: A boat that outruns anything, and one smuggled item a day at cost.

deepworn.name: They drew it underground
deepworn.desc: Every dungeon on this world opens with its map already drawn.

deepworn.name: A dig crew
deepworn.desc: They will open one collapsed mine for you, in an afternoon rather than three days.

greenhand.name: A bed anywhere
greenhand.desc: Rest at any steading on their ground as if it were a town.

stonecount.name: Your face is known
stonecount.desc: No toll gate on this world charges you.

stonecount.name: You hold the chain
stonecount.desc: You collect the toll instead — coin arrives whether you are standing there or not.

quiet_wake.name: They lift it for nothing
quiet_wake.desc: Any curse on any item, taken off free.

quiet_wake.name: Not yet
quiet_wake.desc: One free revive a day, anywhere on the world, with no shrine and no draught.

saltbound.name: Every wreck on the chart
saltbound.desc: All sunken wrecks on this world are marked on your map.

saltbound.name: A diver
saltbound.desc: They will fetch what you cannot reach, out of any water on the world.

emberwrights.name: Half the fee
emberwrights.desc: Branding a weapon costs half what it costs anyone else.

emberwrights.name: Two brands, one blade
emberwrights.desc: One weapon of yours may carry a second element at the same time.

longsight.name: Charted ahead of you
longsight.desc: Every zone is already mapped when you walk into it.

longsight.name: And the ones next door
longsight.desc: The zones touching the one you are in are mapped too.
